note: Golden cases for the Chinese clause layer. Every expected value below was produced by running the primitives and then verified by hand against the source text; changing a value here requires a documented reason, because downstream contract clauses pin numbers derived from these rules. Bracketed/quoted separators must not split (cases 4-5); an unclosed bracket degrades to normal splitting rather than swallowing the rest of the document (case 8).

cases.text: 本文提出一种新方法，并在三个数据集上验证了其有效性。

clauses: 并在三个数据集上验证了其有效性。

cases.note: the baseline shape: one terminal, one comma, two clauses; the separator travels with the clause it ends
sentence_index distinguishes the two clauses even though each has exactly one

cases.text: 该方法存在一定局限……未来工作将解决这一问题。

clauses: 未来工作将解决这一问题。

cases.note: an ellipsis run is ONE terminator at its last character, so the sentence is not fragmented

cases.text: 李明指出：该算法的时间复杂度为O(n)。

clauses: 该算法的时间复杂度为O(n)。

cases.note: a full-width colon is a clause boundary; the ASCII parenthesis inside does not contain a separator here
the comma inside the bracket is masked: one clause, not two

cases.text: 他说“这里，有逗号”，然后继续。
cases.note: the comma inside the quotes is masked; the comma after the closing quote still splits, and the quoted text stays with its reporting clause

cases.text: 本文的主要贡献如下：（1）提出新模型；（2）验证其有效性。
cases.note: semicolons outside brackets split; the （1） prefix stays with its item

cases.text: 我们采用 BERT-base 模型，参数量约 110M，在 GPU 上训练了 24 小时。

clauses: 我们采用 BERT-base 模型，
在 GPU 上训练了 24 小时。

cases.note: mixed CJK/ASCII: commas still split, ASCII terms are single tokens

cases.text: 未闭合的（括号还在后面，继续分句。

clauses: 未闭合的（括号还在后面，

cases.note: an opener with no closer is left alone: subsequent separators still split, instead of blanking the rest of the document

cases.text: Keywords: 关键词一，关键词二
cases.note: keyword lines are masked as non-prose, so they yield neither sentences nor clauses - consistent with split_sentences
no sentences, no clauses, no exception
